steps.message: Discrete LOD on the full soft-mesh path. Unlike the compatibility path, here the selected level has to survive a round trip: cull encodes it in the visibility id, the raster vertex stage resolves the index range from it, and Core.SurfaceBuild / get_material_data must reconstruct the SAME triangle from the visibility pixel. A mismatch does not look like missing geometry -- it looks like wrong normals and materials, because reconstruction lands on a LOD0 triangle that was never drawn.
